scripts.build:react: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:react && npm run copy
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run client"
scripts.clean: rimraf client/dist server/public client/.parcel-cache node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
